summary: Meta's Chief AI Officer announced the release of Muse Spark 1.3, available via Muse Code and the Meta model API, claiming stronger agentic and coding performance and improved usability over prior versions.

practices.reason: The post claims a stronger agentic-coding model with better usability but gives no benchmark figures, so an engineering team would want to evaluate before adopting.
practices.quote: much stronger at agentic and coding with better usability. we think users will really notice the jump.
